result.summary: The home screen renders cleanly overall: header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels, list cards, and bottom navigation are all well aligned with no overlapping, truncated, or misrendered elements. The only questionable item is the empty profile avatar in the top-right corner.

issues.description: The profile avatar in the top-right corner is an empty grey circle with only a small red dot inside it; there is no user photo, initials, or icon, so it reads as a broken/unloaded image rather than an intentional placeholder.
issues.suggestion: Show a default person icon or user initials inside the avatar circle when no photo is available, and position the red notification badge on the circle's edge so it reads as a badge rather than stray content.
